root_cause: V1 reused shaded central black/white swatches to threshold outer markers under different illumination. A tiny antialiased marker could therefore vanish even while its physical location and camera pose were unchanged.
correction: Estimate a local background plane around each expected outer marker. Require a strong dark ink core, identify its connected antialiased support, and use the complete compact square for shape checks and darkness-weighted centroid. This measures image features; no simulator pose is substituted for a marker centre.
unchanged: One raw pixel maximum camera-reference registration displacement.
All inner fiducial enlargement calculations and thresholds.
Both five-bar/four-gap pixel-count rules and reference checks.
All 61 frames, exact camera invariance, resize checks, frozen reference requirements and minimum-over-time hold scoring.

synthetic_tests.interpretation: Synthetic image-counting checks, not rendered optical validation.

detector_bounds.local_background: Robust linear plane from outer fitting ring; RMS residual <=0.06, predicted background >=0.15.
detector_bounds.strong_core: At least two connected pixels, each at least0.15 darker than local background and normalized darkness >=0.45.
detector_bounds.antialiased_support: Connected pixels at least0.08 darker than local background and normalized darkness >=0.20.
detector_bounds.shape: Known projected square size: component area between max(2,0.2×expected area) and1.8×expected area; box sides between max(1,0.4×expected) and1+1.8×expected; relative aspect ratio0.5–2; fill >=0.4; components touching search boundary rejected.

limits: An image hold certificate is not a physical grasp/collision certificate, a Dream result, or submission readiness. Stronger future lighting changes can still make registration inconclusive; failures stay explicit.
